module_summary: Reservoir flow controller: a child six-state level-tracker FSM follows the sensor inputs, and a function decodes its state into flow-rate outputs fr2..fr0 plus the supplemental dfr valve.

anchors.name: zq
anchors.why: Encoded level-tracker state from child; sole input of the flow decoder.

anchors.name: flow_vec
anchors.why: State-decoded flow vector driving all four valve outputs.

anchors.name: fr2
anchors.why: Flow-rate output bit (representative of fr2..fr0) decoded from state.

anchors.name: dfr
anchors.why: Supplemental flow valve output decoded from state.

groups.name: level_tracker
groups.description: rsv_track child FSM following sensor levels with hysteresis.

groups.name: flow_decoder
groups.description: Maps tracker state to flow-rate and supplemental valve outputs.
